title: DCB Sandbox log line
description:
One line of a sandbox log (`*.sandbox.jsonl`): newline-delimited JSON,
one recorded event per line, in the order they were recorded. This
schema describes a line, not the file.

The file is a log and nothing more: no header, no version, no model
name, and no record of which command published what. The playground
writes it from a sandbox run and reads it back as one imported stretch
of events, against whichever model is open.

**Tags are not part of the line.** A reader works out an event's tags
from the model's event definition, as for every other event. A line
may carry `tags` – an event store's export usually does – and any
other field (a position, a timestamp, metadata); a reader ignores them,
though it may say where stated tags differ from the derived ones.

A line whose type the model does not define, or whose `data` does not
fit the event's properties, is skipped and reported; the rest load.

type.description: The event's type – an `eventDefinitions` entry of the model, by name.

data.description:
One entry per property the event declares – all of them, and
nothing else. An optional property's entry holds `null` when it is
unset; an absent entry on an optional property reads the same way,
and an absent `data` reads as an empty object.
